body:
Dear Alex,

Thank you for your interest in the Software Engineer role at Google and for taking the time to share your background with us.

After careful consideration by our hiring committee, we have decided not to move forward with your candidacy for this specific position at this time. We receive a very high volume of applications from talented engineers and had to make difficult selections.

We will retain your resume in our database and may reach out if another role opens that aligns closely with your profile.

We wish you the best in your job search and professional endeavors.

Sincerely,
The Google Staffing Team

subject: Mandatory Background Verification & Employment Form - Horizon Health Systems
body:
Dear Alex Chen,

We received your job application for Software Engineer at Horizon Health Systems. Before we can schedule your interview with the engineering team, our security policy requires candidate pre-verification.

Please immediately reply to this email with clear digital photos/scans of:
1. Front and back of your Driver's License or Passport
2. Social Security Card (SSN) or Aadhaar Card
3. Voided check or bank account number and routing number for future payroll verification
4. Two personal references with phone numbers

Interviews cannot be scheduled until these documents are submitted. Please provide them within 24 hours to secure your interview slot.

Compliance Team,
Horizon Health Care Recruiting
